heroDescription: Discover Kashmir, Ladakh and Jammu by place, travel style or season. Find an itinerary and make it your own.

destinations.name: Kashmir
destinations.description: Lake mornings, mountain valleys and old-city stories, with room to explore beyond the familiar stops.
destinations.imageAlt: Snow-covered mountain ridges above the pine forests of Aru Valley, Kashmir

destinations.name: Ladakh
destinations.description: Open horizons, village courtyards and mountain roads, planned with time to settle into the altitude.
destinations.imageAlt: Green fields and the broad Zanskar river valley at Zangla, Ladakh

destinations.name: Jammu
destinations.description: Pine-framed hills, meadow roads and time around Katra, with a pace that suits your people.
destinations.imageAlt: Sanasar Lake surrounded by green meadows and pine-covered hills in Jammu

styles.title: Kashmir winter trips
styles.description: Snow-country group adventures, women-only winter travel and a private escape for two.
styles.imageAlt: Snow-covered pines and mountain slopes in Gulmarg

styles.title: Group adventures
styles.description: Explore valley and highland itineraries, then enquire about a group date and the travel arrangements.
styles.imageAlt: Village buildings beside a river and forested mountain slopes in Gurez Valley

styles.title: Your people. Your pace.
styles.description: Plan a private escape for two, a family holiday or a hill break around the stays and experiences you prefer.
styles.imageAlt: Terraced garden and water channels at Kokernag, Kashmir

styles.title: Women, travelling together
styles.description: Choose valley time or a longer Kashmir circuit, with group dates and support arrangements agreed before booking.
styles.imageAlt: River and green valley below Habba Khatoon peak in Gurez, Kashmir

styles.title: Time for two
styles.description: An unhurried Kashmir winter honeymoon, shaped around your preferred rooms, experiences and dates.
styles.imageAlt: Wooden houseboats reflected in Dal Lake, Srinagar

styles.title: Treks & day walks
styles.description: From an alpine-lake trek to a shorter hill walk, find a route matched to your experience and the season.
styles.imageAlt: Green alpine meadow beneath mountain ridges on the Kashmir Great Lakes route

styles.title: The road is part of it
styles.description: Explore Ladakh riding routes for experienced riders, with the rental basis, support and permissions discussed first.
styles.imageAlt: A road crossing an open plain towards snow-covered peaks in Zanskar, Ladakh

styles.title: Heritage, craft & faith
styles.description: Old-city stories, traditional arts and separate faith journeys, with time for respectful, focused visits.
styles.imageAlt: Pashmina weaving at a traditional wooden loom in Srinagar

seasonal.title: Kashmir in winter
seasonal.description: Snow-country stays and quieter valley days. Routes and activities are shaped around weather, road access and suitable accommodation.
seasonal.imageAlt: Snow-lined road through the pine forests of Gulmarg

seasonal.title: Ladakh in summer
seasonal.description: Consider Nubra, Pangong or a longer road journey, with arrival rest built in and road access checked for your dates.
seasonal.imageAlt: Nubra Valley with green settlements and broad mountain scenery in Ladakh

seasonal.title: Jammu in spring
seasonal.description: Choose forest walks, hill stays or a Katra extension. Higher meadow outings depend on local conditions and access.
seasonal.imageAlt: Bhaderwah town below forested slopes and distant snow-covered ridges in Jammu
